title: Rear screen (LCD) at 3:2 in movie mode with the focus frames: VDF fills the 3:2 panel with the 16:9 live view, and the frame widgets expect the live view there (A1 II 4.00 port)
artifact: cpapp-b.bin, its loaded image in coprocessor RAM: the word is in the file, the change is made in RAM only
table: VDF fit-mode table 0x1e4bc8 and the frame widgets' rectangle tables 0xd7b560, 0xd7b5d8, 0xd7b650 (entry: rear panel, 16:9) [A7 IV addresses; A1 II: fit function 0x1fac50, fit table 0x1faca0, frame tables 0xf823c4, 0xf8243c, 0xf824b4]

goes_with: the open-gate state (a 16:9 live view holding the whole 3:2 sensor area, squeezed 32/27)

sites.note: VDF fit mode for a 16:9 picture on a 3:2 panel (table for picture code 2, entry for panel code 1): 3 letterbox to 0 fill. The rear screen then shows the squeezed 16:9 live view over the whole 3:2 panel, i.e. stretched x32/27 vertically [A7 IV 0x1e4bcc, A7C II 0x1f8f4c]
